prompt:
On hot days (cabin at 45 C or more) the cabin fan does not go to full speed; it keeps its previous level. The head unit log shows:
I thermal: cabin at 47 C: full fan
E fanctl: fan level too high: 9
Full speed is level 9 and is a valid level. Find the fault. Answer with the file and the function that contain it, and one sentence on why. Do not change any file.
reference_answer: fan/fan.c, fan_set: it rejects level >= FAN_MAX, so the valid maximum level 9 is refused; the check should be level > FAN_MAX.
